meta.greeting: It's a Unix system. You know this.
meta.rationale: Your files as a landscape: folders are platforms you fly into, files are blocks as tall as they are big.
meta.theme-about: 3D file system navigator, after the one in Jurassic Park: a full-screen canvas flying over the real home folder in perspective; folders are teal platforms you click to fly inside, files are blocks sized by their size, apps are tall blue towers along the left; SGI/IRIX look, monospace type, a path readout and a clock. (#fsn, #hud, #launch)

desktop.canvas: local cwd, born, lt, hits, hot = "~", nil, 0, {}, nil local F = 640 local function shade(hex, k) local r = tonumber(hex:sub(2,3),16) * k local gg = tonumber(hex:sub(4,5),16) * k local b = tonumber(hex:sub(6,7),16) * k return string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", math.min(255,math.floor(r)), math.min(255,math.floor(gg)), math.min(255,math.floor(b))) end local KIND = {"#d94c3a", "#e8a33a", "#7cc35a", "#e8d44d", "#b46ad9", "#3aa0d9"} local function kind(name) local h = 0 local ext = name:match("%.([%w]+)$") or name for i = 1, #ext do h = (h * 31 + ext:byte(i)) % 997 end return KIND[h % #KIND + 1] end local W, H, yaw, cy, sy = 1, 1, 0, 1, 0 local CAMY, CAMZ, PZ, CP, SP = 8.5, -11, 8, math.cos(0.5), math.sin(0.5) local function proj(x, y, z) local dx, dz = x, z - PZ local rx, rz = dx * cy - dz * sy, dx * sy + dz * cy + PZ local X, Y, Z = rx, y - CAMY, rz - CAMZ local Y2, Z2 = Y * CP + Z * SP, Z * CP - Y * SP if Z2 < 0.5 then Z2 = 0.5 end return W / 2 + F * X / Z2, H * 0.46 - F * Y2 / Z2, Z2 end local function box(b) local x0, x1, z0, z1, y0, y1 = b.x - b.w / 2, b.x + b.w / 2, b.z - b.d / 2, b.z + b.d / 2, b.y or 0, (b.y or 0) + b.h local P = {} local C = {{x0,y0,z0},{x1,y0,z0},{x1,y0,z1},{x0,y0,z1},{x0,y1,z0},{x1,y1,z0},{x1,y1,z1},{x0,y1,z1}} local minx, miny, maxx, maxy, zs = 1e9, 1e9, -1e9, -1e9, 0 for i = 1, 8 do local sx, sy2, z = proj(C[i][1], C[i][2], C[i][3]) P[i] = {sx, sy2, z} zs = zs + z if sx < minx then minx = sx end if sx > maxx then maxx = sx end if sy2 < miny then miny = sy2 end if sy2 > maxy then maxy = sy2 end end local faces = {{1,2,6,5,0.62},{2,3,7,6,0.5},{4,1,5,8,0.5},{3,4,8,7,0.4},{5,6,7,8,1.0}} for _, f in ipairs(faces) do f.z = (P[f[1]][3] + P[f[2]][3] + P[f[3]][3] + P[f[4]][3]) / 4 end table.sort(faces, function(a, c) return a.z > c.z end) local col = b.hot and shade(b.c, 1.35) or b.c for _, f in ipairs(faces) do local q = {P[f[1]][1],P[f[1]][2],P[f[2]][1],P[f[2]][2],P[f[3]][1],P[f[3]][2],P[f[4]][1],P[f[4]][2]} g.poly(q, shade(col, f[5])) end b.sx, b.sy, b.minx, b.miny, b.maxx, b.maxy, b.depth = P[5][1], P[5][2], minx, miny, maxx, maxy, zs / 8 end local function parent(p) if p == "~" then return "~" end local q = p:match("^(.*)/[^/]+$") return (q == nil or q == "~" or q == "") and "~" or q end function draw(w, h, t) W, H, lt = w, h, t yaw = math.sin(t * 0.07) * 0.32 cy, sy = math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw) g.gradient(0, 0, w, h * 0.5, "#000000", "#06243d") g.gradient(0, h * 0.5, w, h * 0.5, "#06243d", "#010a12") for i = -12, 12 do local ax, ay = proj(i * 2, 0, -4) local bx, by = proj(i * 2, 0, 40) g.line(ax, ay, bx, by, "rgba(47,183,214,0.18)", 1) end for k = -2, 20 do local ax, ay = proj(-24, 0, k * 2) local bx, by = proj(24, 0, k * 2) g.line(ax, ay, bx, by, "rgba(47,183,214,0.18)", 1) end born = born or (t - 1) local rise = math.min(1, (t - born) / 0.7) rise = 1 - (1 - rise) * (1 - rise) local list, blocks, links = g.files(cwd), {}, {} local dirs, files = {}, {} for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e.dir then if #dirs < 9 then dirs[#dirs + 1] = e end elseif #files < 20 then files[#files + 1] = e end end local cols = math.max(1, math.min(5, #files)) local rows = math.max(1, (#files + cols - 1) // cols) local pw, pd = cols * 1.9 + 1.2, rows * 1.9 + 1.2 blocks[#blocks + 1] = {x = 0, z = 6, w = pw, d = pd, h = 0.35, c = "#1f8fa8", label = "", floor = true} for k, e in ipairs(files) do local col, row = (k - 1) % cols, (k - 1) // cols local hh = (0.3 + math.min(2.6, math.log(e.size + 10) / 5)) * rise blocks[#blocks + 1] = {x = (col - (cols - 1) / 2) * 1.9, z = 6 - pd / 2 + 1.55 + row * 1.9, y = 0.35, w = 1.0, d = 1.0, h = hh, c = kind(e.name), label = e.name, act = "file:" .. e.path} end for k, e in ipairs(dirs) do local a = (k - (#dirs + 1) / 2) * 0.36 local bx, bz = math.sin(a) * 15, 6 + math.cos(a) * 15 blocks[#blocks + 1] = {x = bx, z = bz, w = 2.8, d = 2.8, h = 0.9 * rise, c = "#1c7f96", label = e.name .. "/", go = e.path, dir = true} links[#links + 1] = {bx, bz} end for _, l in ipairs(links) do local ax, ay = proj(0, 0.36, 6 + pd / 2) local bx, by = proj(l[1], 0.5, l[2]) g.line(ax, ay, bx, by, "rgba(232,212,77,0.5)", 1.5) end local apps = g.apps() for i, a in ipairs(apps) do if i > 8 then break end blocks[#blocks + 1] = {x = -12.5 + (i - 1) * 0.5, z = 3 + (i - 1) * 2.3, w = 1.0, d = 1.0, h = 2.8 * rise, c = "#2b5fd0", label = a.name, act = "open:" .. a.id} end local px, py, over = g.pointer() for _, b in ipairs(blocks) do b.depth = (b.z - CAMZ) end table.sort(blocks, function(a, c) return a.depth > c.depth end) hot = nil for i = #hits, 1, -1 do local b = hits[i] if over and px >= b.minx and px <= b.maxx and py >= b.miny and py <= b.maxy then hot = b.label break end end for _, b in ipairs(blocks) do b.hot = (b.label ~= "" and b.label == hot) box(b) if b.hot then g.glow(b.sx, b.sy, 60, "rgba(232,212,77,0.35)") end if b.floor then goto continue end local lab = #b.label > 18 and (b.label:sub(1, 17) .. "~") or b.label g.text(b.sx - 4, b.sy - 22, lab, b.hot and "#e8d44d" or "#d8f4ff", b.dir and 14 or 12, "JetBrainsMono") ::continue:: end hits = blocks local shown = cwd == "~" and "~" or cwd:gsub("^.*/root", "~") g.text(24, 22, "fsn " .. shown, "#e8d44d", 17, "JetBrainsMono") if cwd ~= "~" then g.rect(24, 54, 92, 28, "rgba(47,183,214,0.25)", 2) g.text(36, 59, "^ up", "#d8f4ff", 14, "JetBrainsMono") end g.text(24, h - 34, "click a block to open it; a platform takes you inside", "rgba(216,244,255,0.55)", 13, "JetBrainsMono") end function click(x, y) if cwd ~= "~" and x >= 24 and x <= 116 and y >= 54 and y <= 82 then cwd, born = parent(cwd), lt return nil end for i = #hits, 1, -1 do local b = hits[i] if x >= b.minx and x <= b.maxx and y >= b.miny and y <= b.maxy then if b.dir then cwd, born = b.go, lt return nil end return b.act end end end
